videos.title: You've Got Options  | Introducing Logitech MX Keypad  | Built for developers
videos.description:
Take full command of your development workflow with the Logitech MX Keypad.  In this episode of You've Got Options we introduce the Logitech MX Keypad, built for advanced developers and weekend vibe coders alike. 

The MX Keypad comes the 9 customizable LCD keys and allows for context-aware key switching across your IDE, Slack, Chrome and more. We have partnered directly with GitHub so every MX keypad includes a three-month subscription of GitHub Copilot Pro+ on us.

videos.title: Prompt. Build. Control. Logi Actions SDK.
videos.description:
Power your tools with Logi Actions SDK.
The Logi Actions SDK is an open invitation to shape your hardware — whether you're integrating a specific app or chaining multi-tool workflows. Create custom plugins for your own desk, for your team, or publish to the Logi Marketplace to reach over 100 million compatible Logitech devices. With AI-friendly docs, you can turn any idea into a physical control in an afternoon. Join a growing community of plugin makers and power how you work.
